changes.comment: sdk-pluggable-application-model: the AI assistant chat channel is generic in both directions. `IAiAssistantChatEvent` types what the host chat hands to an application (`onAiAssistantEventReceive`) and `IAiAssistantEventSentEvent` carries an `IAiAssistantAppEvent` from the application to the chat; the publisher-document-saved and dashboard-saved pluggable events are now app events under that envelope. sdk-ui-gen-ai: `GenAIChatDialogConnected` takes one `appEvent` prop in place of `publisherDocumentSaved` and `dashboardSaved`.
